name: @kostysh/dossier-engineer-cli
description: CLI runtime for the dossier-engineer skill.

scripts.format: biome format --files-ignore-unknown=true --write src test package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts
scripts.format:check: biome check --files-ignore-unknown=true --formatter-enabled=true --linter-enabled=false --assist-enabled=false src test package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts
scripts.lint:biome: biome lint --files-ignore-unknown=true --diagnostic-level=warn --error-on-warnings src test package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:biome && pnpm run lint:eslint && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.lint:fix: biome lint --files-ignore-unknown=true --diagnostic-level=warn --error-on-warnings --write src test package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && eslint --fix "src/**/*.ts" "test/**/*.ts" "vite.config.ts" && pnpm run typecheck
